frozen_runtime_policy.selected_candidate_authority: The selected candidate must pass exact-DP replay, polynomial intermediate envelope, all internal reducer replays, and independent full R47M replay.

frozen_runtime_policy.restart: Set current state to the selected normalized successor and scan again from its first canonical variable.
frozen_runtime_policy.stop_failure: If a nonterminal capped state has no cap-preserving certified pivot, seal that exact state and every candidate receipt as an explicit finite counterexample to this proposed CAP-PROJECTION grammar.
